card.name: Partway through words before solution nouns
card.fires_on: Word-start or word-middle pieces such as 'ophthalm-ic', 'parent-eral', 're-constituted' and 'ant-i...' that come right before a noun like solution, nutrition or injection. Also the word 'of' after 'constructed'.

modes.label: Medical word pieces
modes.description: Partway through a medical word that is about to be completed, often before solution or nutrition.

modes.label: Anti- words
modes.description: The start 'ant' of antiseptic or anticonvulsant after with or Administer.

modes.label: Material 'of'
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'constructed' in a building description.
modes.example: The basement and first two floors are constructed<< of>> granite.

card.plain: It fires on the unfinished front part of a long medical word, such as parenteral or antiseptic, just before the word is completed.
evidence: Convert patients receiving parent<<eral>> oxymorphone to Oxymor
